item.title: Unitree Opens a Tianjin Subsidiary to Prototype Power-Inspection and Logistics-Sorting Robots
item.description: Unitree's new Tianjin unit began operating on November 7 and will prototype power-inspection and logistics-sorting robots with state-linked partners. Robot models and timelines were not disclosed.

item.title: DIYgod Open-Sources Pinky, an MCP Layer That Lets AI Agents Operate Real iPhones and Android Phones
item.description: DIYgod's Pinky, open-sourced under Apache-2.0, lets MCP-compatible AI agents operate real iPhones and Android phones with gateway-enforced approvals, logs and a human takeover option.

item.title: MiniMax Opens Weights for H3-Image, a 16-Megapixel Text-to-Image and Editing Model Run in Six Steps
item.description: MiniMax released H3-Image weights: a 33.1B diffusion transformer that makes 16MP images in six steps and edits with up to 16 references. A community licence sets a territory.

item.title: Huawei's openJiuwen Unveils TTSE, an Agent Framework That Splits Environment Facts From Tips
item.description: openJiuwen's TTSE sorts agent experience into environment facts and conditional tips. The team reports 97.8% on ALFWorld and cuts office-task tool calls in demos; results are its own.

item.title: Huawei Schedules Trial Launch of a New Magnetoelectric Disk Storage System in Gui'an
item.description: Huawei plans a November 12 trial launch in Gui'an of a storage system built on its MED magnetoelectric disk, aiming for tape-like cost and hard-drive-like retrieval. No specs are public.
